subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should OpenClaw require a current-main or newest-release redacted Slack Socket Mode envelope and Gateway-log reproduction before any code change for this issue?
rationale: The source and tests prove handler-level support, but they do not prove where the live Socket Mode event first disappears, and the issue already has a maintainer request for that boundary evidence.

options.title: Require live boundary evidence
options.body: Keep the issue open and wait for redacted Socket Mode envelope fields plus nearby Gateway logs before patching.

options.title: Sponsor diagnostic logging
options.body: Ask an owner to add narrowly scoped debug instrumentation around Socket Mode receipt and account filtering so affected users can gather the missing evidence.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode liveness work
options.body: Route this under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 only if maintainers decide the reaction-only symptom is caused by the broader no-event WSS failure.

recommendation.title: Require live boundary evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and wait for redacted Socket Mode envelope fields plus nearby Gateway logs before patching.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee/commenter and has already framed the proof needed to choose the boundary safely.
